wentPoorly: The installed app was downgraded to v0.26.0 mid-sprint and refused schema v14, so the run continued on a CLI built from img-s2, and three leases expired and had to be reconciled.
The orchestrator's DM-435 brief contradicted itself about running examples, and the worker staged two test images in the live project.
PR #18 conflicted with main, which stopped CI until main was merged. That merge exposed two defects that had to be fixed after the increment.
The orchestrator's DM-429 submission notes mislabelled exit criteria x2 to x5 and had to be corrected with a comment.
CI needed a rerun because of a real-git timeout under coverage.
wentWell: All 15 sprint 2 tickets were accepted on their first attempt with no rejections, and all 9 row checks passed.
Planning before the sprint (fixing exact file anchors, optional view fields and the save-path rules in DM-432) meant no ticket had to be re-scoped mid-sprint, and the plan was never redrafted.
DM-482 made the full suite pass locally, so the acceptance round could run the Definition of Done on this machine instead of relying only on CI.
The acceptance round caught real integration defects: dead exports, a coverage shortfall, and after the main merge, card deletion leaving images behind.

risks: The CI test job passed only after one rerun. Real-git tests time out at 15s under coverage on the Windows runner; main has the same flake (installer-nsh.test.mjs). Filed as a Kanban card.
Branch coverage is 95.06% against a 95% threshold, so a small change could fail the gate.

The installed app (v0.26.0) is older than schema v14. During this sprint the orchestrator ran the dm CLI built from img-s2, and three expired leases were reconciled as resubmits. Install a build from this branch, or later, before using the desktop app on this folder.

The DM-435 worker ran runbook examples against the live project, which staged two test images (im_01m6qs5y3bv6w8hkt9e1xzmg82, im_01m6qs63d43msqbx8bd3my81vq). They were never claimed, so they prune automatically.
The DM-429 submission notes paraphrased exit criteria x2 to x5 wrongly. A ticket comment on DM-429 corrects the mapping, and the exit criteria below are correct.
content.summary: Sprint 2, the final sprint, is done. Images now work as references on comments, Kanban cards and plan tickets. Agents add them with the dm CLI, including --args-file input for Windows paths. People add them in the app by pasting, dropping or picking a file in the comment composer, card form and ticket editor. The attachment pipeline was hardened: dimensions are decoded from the image bytes, claims for unknown owners are refused, and attachment metadata is exported as sidecars that keep createdBy through a state.sqlite rebuild. Storage status shows image totals and failed exports, and the guides, CLI runbook and decision record 0006 document the feature. All 14 work tickets and the acceptance node DM-429 were accepted with no rejections. The squashed increment 4d2c54e passed every verification check. All seven epic success criteria are met with evidence. One caveat: the CI test job needed one rerun, because two real-git tests outside this epic's code timed out under coverage.
